enabled.description: Send notify-send desktop notifications. Default true (master /notify toggle still applies on top)
Mirror notifications into herdr when running inside a herdr session (HERDR_ENV=1). Default true
Send ntfy push notifications to your homelab server. Default true when this section is present

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the ntfy server, e.g. https://ntfy.homelab.local (no trailing slash needed)

topic.description: ntfy topic to publish to, e.g. "pi-notifications" (secret topics are fine)

token.description: Bearer token for ntfy access control. Prefer the PI_NTFY_TOKEN env var for secrets — the env var wins when both are set

priority.description: ntfy message priority 1-5 (default 3 = high; 5 = max priority with persistent notification)

tags.description: Emoji tags for the message, e.g. ["robot", "white_check_mark"] (names or raw emoji)

clickUrl.description: URL opened when the notification is tapped (optional)

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for the ntfy publish request (default 5000 ms)

notifyOnPrompt.description: Also notify (all enabled channels, ignoring the idle threshold) when Pi shows a blocking user prompt — select/confirm/input/editor/custom via ui_prompt_start. Default true
